posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower posterior haunch are aligned horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the ocular regions; distinct white patch on the lower mandible/cheek area; white horizontal band on the proximal segment of the forelimb.
